name: ht
description: LUMINA hotel, dining, and booking website

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pages=['index.html','about.html','stay.html','reserve.html','menu.html','gallery.html','contact.html','admin-inbox.html','favicon.svg','robots.txt','sitemap.xml']; for(const dir of ['public','dist']) { fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); for(const file of pages) fs.copyFileSync(file,dir+'/'+file); for(const assetDir of ['css','js']) { fs.mkdirSync(dir+'/'+assetDir,{recursive:true}); for(const file of fs.readdirSync(assetDir)) fs.copyFileSync(assetDir+'/'+file,dir+'/'+assetDir+'/'+file); } }"
